exposure of healthy adult rats to enhanced concentrations of fine/ultra fine fractions of ambient PM in a heavily polluted urban area (i.e., Fresno) is associated with a mild, but significant increase in cellular effects in the lung.
exposure to concentrated PM in the California central valley is associated with cytotoxic effects in the lungs and airways of healthy adult rats.
